steps.name: dmabuf-system-heap-read-only
steps.subject: DmaBufAllocator: open the system heap read-only when read-write is refused
steps.description:
The Plasma container gets /dev/dma_heap/system with read access only (LXC device rule), and
allocation needs no more (DMA_HEAP_IOCTL_ALLOC works on a read-only descriptor). A read-write open
that fails with EACCES is retried read-only for the system heap.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [a container that grants the heap read-only]

steps.name: virtual-pipewire-frames
steps.subject: Virtual pipeline: frames from an existing PipeWire video source
steps.description:
A virtual camera whose configuration names pipewire_node takes its frames from that PipeWire
Video/Source (the Android camera bridge, rungic-camera-source) through pipewiresrc, on demand; the
sensor timestamp is the frame's time. libcamera applications (Plasma Camera) then use the same
camera as PipeWire applications, with no second path to the Android camera.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [Android camera bridge of this project]
dep3.X-Rungic-Tests: none (gap: no scenario uses the libcamera path)
